messages.subject: Query regarding manually modifying states_list
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,
I'm examining how various processes have influenced the distribution of reptiles across different biogeographic regions within Peninsular India. My study has a total of 9 areas (the number of areas increasing or decreasing wrt certain groups), and I'm trying to edit my possible state combinations manually. The question I have is: do I have to manually edit all the possible state combinations (including 3 & 4 area combinations) or do I have to just mention the non-adjacent areas (as mentioned in http://phylo.wikidot.com/example-biogeobears-scripts#manual_modify_states

Here is the code I'm using in my ancestral area reconstruction, attached as a .txt file for reference
